## Compforge checklist

- [ ] The change has one architecture or policy decision
- [ ] Skills stay ≤200 lines and remain registered
- [ ] Maintained source/docs stay ≤300 lines, or the exception is explained
- [ ] Hard Rules remain canonical in `skills/principles/hard-rules.md`
- [ ] Stable paths and harness claims match `docs/reference/support-scope.md`
- [ ] User-visible completed work is recorded under `CHANGELOG.md` → `Unreleased`

- [ ] `./scripts/ci/smoke-test.sh`

- [ ] Authenticated live harness smoke, if a load path changed
